risks.risk: Brand/model/capacity not fully verifiable from the single photo; price depends heavily on capacity and exact model.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the rating plate/model sticker (usually at the back or inside the lid) showing model number and capacity (kg).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic working top-loading washing machine with unknown capacity (use the lowest matching comparables).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (no run/test, no sound/vibration check).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip of a full wash cycle starting from power-on through draining/spin (or at least agitation + drain/spin).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven—assume worst case for remote pricing: treat as potentially needing service (use the cheapest comparable).

risks.risk: Possible missing accessories/installation parts (inlet hose, drain hose, knob/cover, manual).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing all included parts laid out (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable, knobs/attachments).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the low end until accessories are confirmed.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/physical condition (dents, rust, leaks) not assessable from this angle.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the bottom edge, around the drain area, and any visible dents/rust.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the low end until no leaks/damage is confirmed.

proof_requests: Photo of the rating plate/model sticker showing exact model number and capacity (kg).
Video of a full wash cycle (agitation + drain + spin) with the machine running.
Photos of included accessories (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable, any knobs/parts) laid out.
Close-up photos of bottom edge/drain area to check for leaks/rust/dents.
response.reason: The photo clearly shows a NEXUS top-loading washing machine, but key details (model/capacity) and working condition are not verifiable remotely; so it should be priced at the worst case using the cheapest comparable that matches a washing machine in Lagos.
